scripts.build:frontend: pnpm -C frontend install && pnpm -C frontend build
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun build src/cli/main.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/cli/main.js && mkdir -p dist/server/public && cp src/server/public/app.js dist/server/public/app.js && cp src/server/public/index.html dist/server/public/index.html && cp src/server/public/styles.css dist/server/public/styles.css
